typography.guidelines: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans. Headings must have tracking-tight. Overlines uppercase + tracking-[0.2em].

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders for main dashboard areas, exposing the skeleton. Glassmorphism ONLY for floating modals or sticky headers.
visual_enhancers.effects: Subtle noise texture overlay. Tracing Beam effect for the AI recommendation cards. No full-screen gradients.

grids.dashboard_mode: High Density Grid. Tight gaps (gap-4). Every pixel utilized.
grids.canvas_mode: Blueprint dot grid background. Absolute positioning for nodes.

layouts.app_shell: 3-column layout: Left Sidebar (Components), Center Canvas (Infrastructure Builder), Right Panel (Inspector/Costs/AI).

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states must have higher contrast. Buttons slide up slightly (-translate-y-0.5) with shadow-md.
motion.loading: Retro-terminal ASCII loaders or simple monospace text counters.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for text. Never rely on color alone for states.
accessibility.focus: Focus rings must use primary color (focus:ring-yellow-400 focus:ring-offset-zinc-950).

components.cards: Flat background, 1px border, no shadow by default.
components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Primary button uses solid Warning Yellow.
components.tabs: Shadcn tabs, customized to have transparent background with bottom border for active state.
components.charts: Recharts. Area charts for cost simulation over time with yellow/green gradients.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a 3-column dashboard layout mimicking a professional IDE / Cloud Console.
Left column: Toolbox for dragging and dropping infrastructure resources (VMs, DBs, Network, Storage).
Center column: Interactive infrastructure canvas using `@xyflow/react` (or a custom node-based UI) over a dotted blueprint grid.
Right column: Accordion or Tabs containing 1) Resource Properties, 2) Cost Analysis & charts, 3) AI Recommendations, 4) Terraform Code Output.
Ensure all state interacts: adding a resource updates the cost estimate and the Terraform code live.
Implement the UI entirely without watermarks. Do NOT include any 'Powered by AI' or vendor text.
Implement Sonner for toast notifications (e.g., when Terraform config is generated or validated).
Add `data-testid` attributes to all interactive elements.

Generate a very detailed, professional `README.md` at the root of the project. It should document the architecture, how to run it, the features (drag-and-drop builder, cost estimation, AI insights, Terraform export), and should be written to attain '200 marks' for an academic or high-end professional submission. Also DO NOT put any watermark anywhere.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Do NOT use Inter. Do NOT center align everything.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth with z-index hierarchy and crisp borders.
DO NOT apply `transition: all` anywhere. Use explicit transitions.
NO complete transparent background in overlays/dropdowns.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid.
